propositions: The module-size allowlist and ceilings files are orphaned after Phase 2a merged the absolute cap gate and must be deleted via git rm.

The module-size policy documentation in docs/architecture.md and AGENTS.md still references the deprecated allowlist and offenders table and must be updated to describe the absolute 800 LOC cap with admin-locked limit.

Three stale comments in the reconciler codebase incorrectly state that route_inbound_probe lives in or stays in reconcile.py, but it was moved to reconcile_helpers.py and re-exported; these comments must be corrected.
A contract test must be added to tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py asserting the allowlist and ceilings files no longer exist.
All deletions and documentation/comment updates are mechanical with no runtime logic changes and must land after Phase 2a so the CI gate has already stopped reading the deleted files.
